title: 🚨 MOST CHRISTIANS KNOW CHURCH…
paragraphs:
🚨 MOST CHRISTIANS KNOW CHURCH…
BUT FEW KNOW HOW TO ACTUALLY DISCIPLE SOMEONE.
That’s the problem.

We have endless sermons.
Endless content.
Endless opinions.
But very few believers who know how to help someone grow from new believer → spiritual maturity.
And because of that…

People stay spiritually immature for years.
They know verses… but not transformation.
They attend church… but never become disciple-makers.

⚠️ Jesus did NOT say:
“Go and make church attenders.”

He said:
“Go and make disciples.” — Matthew 28:19
“How to Disciple Someone from Start to Spiritual Maturity”
This is not a motivational Christian read.
This is a practical spiritual training manual for believers who are serious about helping others grow in Christ.
This book will teach you:

• How to disciple new believers step-by-step
• What to teach FIRST (most people get this wrong)
• How to help someone fight sin biblically
• How to build spiritual discipline and consistency
• How to walk people through doubt, weakness, and spiritual warfare
• How to move someone from consumer Christianity into spiritual maturity
• How mature believers multiply disciples
🔥 THIS BOOK WILL CHALLENGE YOU.

Because discipleship is not:
❌ Posting Bible verses only
❌ Giving random advice
❌ Acting spiritually deep online

Real discipleship costs time.
Patience.
Correction.
Prayer.
Consistency.

Most believers want influence.
Few want responsibility.

Most want to be inspired.
Few want to help carry someone else’s spiritual burden.

Most consume content.
Few build people.
The question is:
Which one are you becoming?
⚔️ THIS IS FOR PEOPLE WHO ARE DONE PLAYING CHURCH.

People who want:
• Depth over hype
• Transformation over performance
• Obedience over excuses
• Spiritual maturity over emotional cycles

Inside the library you’ll get:
✅ Discipleship resources
✅ Spiritual warfare teachings
✅ Biblical growth guides
✅ Daily faith-building content
✅ Ongoing exclusive releases

100+ powerful Christian resources already available…
and growing almost daily.
This is becoming more than a page.
It’s becoming a movement of believers pursuing holiness, discipline, repentance, spiritual growth, and biblical truth.
If you’re ready to stop staying spiritually stagnant…
If you’re ready to become someone who helps others grow…
If you’re ready to become a disciple-maker—
